DIAGNOSIS READY: Vestibular Neuritis.

The negative Dix-Hallpike and normal audiogram rule out BPPV and Meniere's, and the lack of limb weakness makes Multiple Sclerosis unlikely. The persistent imbalance without positional triggers points to an isolated vestibular nerve inflammation.
